text:
olivia: quick note from UX review: in-product help panel has three small but annoying inconsistencies vs docs: 1) copy mismatch (console: "Pin model" vs docs: "Freeze version"), 2) deeplinks from docs sometimes open the panel but don't scroll to the right heading, 3) focus outline in dark mode is almost invisible.

mike: thx. repro for focus: open help panel in dark, tab to first link 14 outline blends with bg. i can change :focus-visible to var(--accent-contrast).

jordan: deeplink issue likely alias mismatch of anchor ids. docs use "pinning" but console uses "pin-model". suggest alias map: ["pinning","pin-model","freeze-version"]. try fallback and scrollIntoView. i'll add an axe check for dialog semantics while i'm at it.

sam: +1 on canonicalizing copy. propose "Pin model version" explicitly. also: add analytics events help_panel_pin_cta and help_anchor_resolved so we can see which aliases are used.

docs-bot: noted: docs PR #1423 standardizes docs term to "Pin model version" and adds redirects for old anchors.

aria-bot: accessibility tip: run scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) then focus; ensure focus ring update after scroll so screen readers don't land offscreen.

eng-oncall: pinged for awareness of overlay change in case it impacts long-lived sessions.

olivia: cool. owners: mike -> focus ring CSS, jordan -> anchor alias & e2e axe test, sam -> analytics, docs-bot -> redirects. target: ship before next deploy. :thumbsup:
